title: What If Friction Disappeared For 5 Seconds?
pinned_comment: Physics fun fact: a car could still turn a corner with zero friction if the road were banked at exactly the right angle. Would you have known that?

shots.visual: Mascot in a cozy modern living room raises his chunky stopwatch toward camera, thumb on the button, wide-eyed.
Mascot balancing with arms out, sneakers skidding on a shiny wooden floor, huge delighted grin.
Low side angle: mascot gliding across the living room past the couch like an ice skater, motion streaks.
Mascot flailing arms, panicked, sliding fast toward a wall, a picture frame on the wall ahead.
Close-up of mascot's white sneakers spinning in place on the floor like cartoon running, no progress.
Macro shot: a smartphone slipping out from between the mascot's thumb and finger, mid-air, his shocked face blurred behind.
Macro shot of a white sneaker, the shoelace bow sliding loose and unravelling by itself.
Overhead view of a sunny suburban road bend, several cartoon cars drifting straight off the curve onto the grass.
Top-down shot of one car sliding straight down an empty road, a long dotted measuring line behind it.
Extreme close-up of the mascot's stopwatch, needle one tick from zero, dramatic dark lighting.
Floor-level shot: the mascot's sneaker suddenly gripping the wooden floor, a burst of dust, squeak lines.
Side view, slow motion: mascot pitching forward over his stopped feet toward the couch cushions, eyes wide.
Wide shot: the mascot's slide path across the living room shown as a glowing trail, ending at the couch.
Mascot face-down in the couch cushions, one arm up giving a shaky thumbs-up, stopwatch in the other hand.
Mascot sitting up, looking straight into the lens with a mischievous smile, thumb hovering over the stopwatch button.
